report.title: Dependency Report
report.gloss.all_dependencies: The whole audited set: the sum of the analysed dependencies, with no category filter.
report.gloss.zombies: It's in your production dependencies, but nothing in the code imports it — you pay the weight without using it. Development-only tools (ruff, pytest) don't count here.
report.gloss.ghosts: Your code imports it, but it isn't declared. It works on your machine because it came along as another package's transitive dependency — and breaks in a clean environment. Declare it.
report.gloss.outdated: Used and declared, but PyPI already has a newer version than the one you use.
report.gloss.healthy: Declared and actually used by the code. It does not mean "up to date": a healthy dependency can still be outdated.
report.gloss.unknown: With no Lock and no pinned version, ORÁCULO cannot know the version in use — so Size and Age stay blank too. A Lock file would resolve it.
report.gloss.not_applicable: The value doesn't exist by definition — like the origin of a package the code imports but no Declaration lists. Unlike Undetermined, no extra file would fill it in.
report.warning.not_run: Analysis not performed. Go back Home and start the audit.
